description: The warning comes as a commercial vessel is hit off Qatar, and both the UAE and Kuwait report drone attacks.

title: Temple Israel rebuilds after terror attack
description: Two months ago, a gunman drove through the preschool at Temple Israel, the largest synagogue in Michigan. Every child and teacher survived, but the community is still displaced and navigating the trauma of the attack.
